title: Fix React Object as Child Error in Label Rendering
description: Fix the React error: Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {label}) in span component
summary: Fixed Objects not valid as React child error. Added resolveTranslationLabel() utility to safely extract strings from i18n translation objects. Wrapped all problematic t()/i18n.t() calls in the sketchpad toolbar, dropzone, and port/tag sections.
